body:
Founder real-time, citing a real, named source (AlphaStar league YouTube explainer, 13:01-13:55): addressed cyclic dominance in §25.4's existing plain-PFSP autocurriculum by adding a real three-role league (Main/Main-Exploiter/League-Exploiter), each contributing permanent, never-evicted checkpoints to a shared cross-process registry. New scripts/rl_league.py: LeagueRole enum, shared PFSP weighting (pfsp_weight/pfsp_sample, standard hard-biased direction for Main/League-Exploiter, inverted easy-biased for Main-Exploiter's own real 'climb down through Main's history when struggling' behavior), LeagueManager (permanent, append-only, atomic-rename JSON-file registry -- no locking needed across real concurrent writers), Main-Exploiter's struggle-detection + periodic full-reset-to-fresh-network cadence. 29 unit tests, pure Python, no gymnasium/SB3 dependency -- caught 2 real bugs live: str(LeagueRole.MAIN) formatting (Enum.__str__ beats the str mixin) and a training-loop timesteps counter that silently breaks the moment a mid-run Main-Exploiter reset zeroes a fresh model's own counter (fixed via a delta-based accumulator). Wired additively into rl_env_team.py's ArenaTeamVecEnv (league_manager=None is byte-for-byte the pre-existing behavior, verified via --smoke-test) and rl_train_team.py (--league/--league-role/--league-dir/--league-reset-every-n-generations). New scripts/run_league.sh orchestrates all three roles as concurrent processes against one shared registry. NORTHSTAR.md §25.4.1 documents the design, names the real 'current Main = freshest registered checkpoint, not a live in-memory model' multi-process scope tradeoff, and is explicit that the climb-down bias direction is this module's own reasonable interpretation of the video's described behavior, not a verbatim published formula. REDGARDEN commit d6194d6. Real, honest, NOT done: no full multi-hour three-process training run was launched this session (real GPU/CPU cost, a founder-scheduling decision matching this repo's own established posture for every prior autocurriculum/noisy-gestalt run) -- the mechanism is real and tested, whether it measurably reduces cyclic dominance in practice is the real, open, next question.

⚓ ☃
title: AlphaStar-style league training added (NORTHSTAR §25.4.1)
